limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter wrap but also made ready_a high during reset and before the first post-reset clock edge, and suppressed valid_b on stalled cycles at count 5, all of which the reference fix preserves.

The test exercised reset and stalls before the sixth bit, but its expectations encoded the rewrite’s always-high ready and sixth-transfer-only valid pulse, so it passed despite the timing differences.
